spin_parameter_definition: S = |omega| * R_ball / v (HANDOFF section 4; R_ball = ball radius, v = exit speed relative to air)

measured_v.label: confirmed (fitted data span, Fig. 8; launcher range stated as 5-13 m/s)

S.label: confirmed (backspin, figure reading; topspin up to 0.65)

rows.method: two cameras at 300 fps, trajectory fit
rows.notes: Unreviewed single-author web article with its own measurements; no data released. Cd about 0.45 (26-hole) and 0.33 (40-hole), no drag crisis. Backspin |Cl| about 0.173 + 0.02 S (S <= 0.37), nearly flat with S; near-zero-spin offsets +0.17 (backspin) / -0.24 (topspin); the offset may not be Magnus lift. Steyn et al.: Cl about 0.195 S. Re 2.95e4-5.67e4 (confirmed, data span), overlaps POLLEN upper range. No reverse Magnus for backspin. NOT POLLEN data (HANDOFF section 5).

rows.source: Kim, Choi, Park, Inverse Magnus effect on a rotating sphere: when and why, JFM 754 R2 (2014)
rows.config: rotating sphere in wind tunnel
rows.notes: Negative lift (inverse Magnus) at some Re/S combinations near the drag crisis. POLLEN Re about 2.4e4-5.7e4 at 5-12 m/s (derived) is below that window; perforations change transition anyway.
